note: A written demo script of the 'sent too much by mistake' scam, as an elder we phoned on Oct 31, 2026 described the call that cost him Rs 20,000. Not a real call: the names are made up.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Namaste uncle, main Ramesh bol raha hoon, Suresh bhaiya ka dost. Bhaiya ne kaha tha aapko pachees hazaar rupaye bhejne hain.

turns.speaker: listener
turns.text: Achha, haan, Suresh ne bataya tha.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Main abhi Google Pay se bhej raha hoon. Aapke phone pe message aa jayega, dekh lijiye.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Uncle, message aaya? Arre, galti se pachees ki jagah paintalees hazaar chale gaye. Mera haath galat jagah dab gaya.

turns.speaker: listener
turns.text: Haan, message mein paintalees hazaar likha hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Uncle please, baaki ke bees hazaar isi number pe wapas bhej dijiye. Mujhe abhi hospital mein jama karne hain, jaldi kijiye.
